initializationRaceFailure.status: historical failure; resolved and verified in latestCompletedRun
failureEvidence: Desktop /api/state requests aborted near 5 seconds before the welcome/ready UI.
390px API snapshot object UUID was absent from the rendered builder options.
initializationRaceFailure.cause: Initial request(state) ran outside the mutation queue while the 2500ms reconnect interval could concurrently request state without a cookie. A slow initial generation could create two identities; a late cookie response could disagree with the accepted client player.
initializationRaceFailure.resolution: Bootstrap and reconnect share createStateLoader in-flight state; reconnect skips pending initialization. Initial-state timeout is 20 seconds while ordinary saves keep their original limit. Read-only door fitting is cached and invalidated by structure/terrain state.
